correctness.rationale: Read all frozen RESULT.md. The complete vertex set is {±v_S: nonempty S subset[d]}, v_S,i=ell/2 for i in S and a-ell/2 otherwise; the active-facet argument gives extremality and excludes missing vertices. Symmetric signs center the measure and the exact nonempty-subset marginal and pair probabilities are 2^(d-1)/(2^d-1), 2^(d-2)/(2^d-1). The off-diagonal covariance ((2^d-4)a²+4a ell-ell²)/(4(2^d-1)) and diagonal imply λperp=2^(d-2)(ell-a)²/(2^d-1); λparallel/λperp=1+d/2^d((2^d-1)x²+2x-1), x=a/(ell-a). Its derivative is positive, crosses one only at x=1/(2^(d/2)+1), giving a/ell=1/(2+2^(d/2)). Exact independent enumeration and rational moments in dimensions 2–7 verified values; difference in squared radii for successive subset sizes is a(ell-a)>0. Endpoints excluded because vertex counting changes at coalescence; finite samples are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Vertex-uniform versus volume-uniform inertia are genuinely different natural measures on a well-studied symmetric polytope. The exact unique isotropic cant provides an all-dimensional tight-frame and covariance-conditioning characterization, relevant to sampling discrete vertex supports; the noncospherical d-shell phenomenon makes it structurally nontrivial.

final_claim: For every d>=2 and 0<a<ell, the uniform counting law on the 2^(d+1)-2 distinct vertices of the centered isocanted cube has two exact covariance eigenvalues, transverse 2^(d-2)(ell-a)²/(2^d-1) and axial as in the source; the covariance is isotropic at exactly a/ell=1/(2+2^(d/2)), with sharp condition-number minimum 1 and d distinct vertex radii.
